purpose: Change-label review viewer for the journal1 A+B mismatch candidates: human 3-way labeling (CHANGE / NO_CHANGE / ABSTRACTION_MISMATCH) of E1 point cloud vs existing LoD2 RoofSurface overlay. Labels feed the D-F stratified aggregation only; no metric, gate, or verdict is computed here.
excluded_tiers_note: C_CONSISTENT (59) is not a review target; NA_E1_INSUFFICIENT (72) is undecidable by design and stays NA.
z_shift_provenance: configs/p2/e1_e6_roofer_ox_review_v1/reference_auto_ox_v1.json structure_metric.lod2_reference_z_shift_to_viewer_m (sealed v22 datum bridge). Viewer-local LoD2 z = gml z - 550 + 45.7.

asset_lineage.E1: current UAS LiDAR, sealed C1_L_upper classified_scene footprint+3m crop (viewer-local)
asset_lineage.E2: current-image MVS, sealed C2_MVS classified_scene footprint+3m crop (viewer-local); optional comparison toggle only

serve_note: python3 -m http.server 8881 --bind 0.0.0.0 (run from out_dir; port 8880 stays reserved for the gate5 dashboard)

sensor_overlay.scene_lineage_note: sealed shared-footprint-v3 classified scenes (byte-identical to the gate5 crop producer's non-replay copies); all classes kept — overlays encode acquisition extent, not classification

overview_map.note: map.html + map_data.json go into out_dir so the 8881 server serves them; first-pass classes are review support only (B tier carries the reviewer's 2026-08-12 no-change declaration).

coverage_diagnostic.note: Advisory evaluability support only (user boundary proposal 2026-08-12): a building where neither E1 nor E2 covers >= gate_min_cover of the LoD2 roof polygon is an exclusion candidate, pending human confirmation. Never a training/parameter input.
